record.tranche_reason: The README reports a behavioral A/B smoke test of a prebuilt Heretic model, a weight-modified model, rather than the original all-layer residual-direction projection method.
record.gate_note: The README explicitly reports that stock gpt-oss:20b refuses a harmful prompt and svjack/gpt-oss-20b-heretic complies. The planned benchmark protocol and further tests are not results. The benign-prompt Ollama error and DIY ablation stall are reported as operational problems, not capability results. The listed report files are not provided here, so no additional findings are extracted from them.
record.test_reason: The README reports a stock-vs-abliterated A/B on a released model: stock gpt-oss:20b refuses a harmful prompt and the community Heretic build complies. That is direct, if minimal, evidence for V2 in a new setting (a 20B MoE reasoning-style model). No direction is computed, so V1 and the other versions are not tested.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The README reports that the prebuilt Heretic build passed a behaviour-level decensoring smoke test that the stock model failed. Benchmarking (refusal rate, KL vs stock) and a reproducible DIY ablation pipeline remain incomplete. The repo later moved to an Abliteration.ai backend.
record.recipe_differences: The reported result uses a prebuilt Heretic model and a behavioral comparison; it does not report the original difference-in-means direction or all-layer projection procedure. This is an evidence repo with a partial local/GCP harness, not a complete fresh-clone ablation and benchmark pipeline.
record.problems: The claim-relevant evidence is a single qualitative smoke test with no prompt-set details, quantitative refusal measure, or uncertainty. The README reports a benign-prompt Ollama error for the Heretic build, attributed as likely MPS OOM, but does not establish a model capability failure. The complete pipeline and benchmark protocol are not yet present.
record.rows_left_out: No additional claim-relevant results are stated in the supplied README. Planned tests, operational problems, and listed report files whose contents are not supplied are not extracted as rows.

record.verdict_notes: I dropped the reader's limits_scope label for V2: it was based on untested aspects (prompt breadth, capability retention), which belong under untested. I changed the tranche from T2 to T3 because the study uses no new method; it applies released abliteration to a new model family. The evidence is very weak: a hobbyist repo, n=1, unpeer-reviewed, and an unknown repack procedure.
